cover: Questions for your next recovery rehearsal

slides.title: When was a backup last restored?
slides.body: And how long did the restore take with real data? That time is your actual recovery time.

slides.title: How much would we lose right now?
slides.body: Back up nightly and a 4pm failure can cost a day of orders. Compare that with the loss you agreed you could accept.

slides.title: Where would the app run?
slides.body: Data isn't enough. Check hosting, settings and secrets, the payment, email and accounting connections, and the domain.

slides.title: Who does each step, with what access?
slides.body: The runbook should say who does what, in what order. Check that those people can actually get in.

slides.title: What if the hosting account is locked?
slides.body: Backups kept in a separate account or region, with their own access controls, stop one bad login taking out both.

slides.title: What went wrong this time?
slides.body: Write down the time each drill took. Treat a failed restore as an incident and fix it.
